style: Clean modern editorial illustration with soft natural colours, gentle shading and clear shapes, like a picture in a Japanese children's magazine or recipe book. One clear subject, uncluttered background, square composition. Absolutely no text, no letters, no kana, no kanji, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no sound-effect lettering, no watermark, no signature. Original artwork, not imitating any specific artist or work.

pilot.ぽかぽか: A cat curled up asleep on a window sill in warm afternoon sunshine, soft golden light, a sleepy cosy mood.
pilot.ほかほか: A bowl of freshly cooked white rice with plenty of steam rising from it, held in two hands, close-up.
pilot.ひんやり: A hand resting on a cool smooth stone surface beside a glass of water with ice cubes, pale blue tones, a refreshing cool feeling.
pilot.ぐつぐつ: A pot of stew at a rolling simmer on a stove, big bubbles breaking at the surface, a wooden spoon beside it.
pilot.じゅうじゅう: Meat sizzling on a hot grill pan with small splashes of oil and rising smoke, close-up, warm orange tones.
pilot.ざあざあ: Heavy downpour of rain pouring down hard on a city street, water streaming, a person running with a bag over their head.
pilot.しとしと: Fine gentle drizzle falling quietly on a hydrangea garden, a calm person under an umbrella, soft grey-green tones.
pilot.ふかふか: A thick, plump, freshly aired futon bedding piled up in the sun, a hand pressing gently into it so it sinks.
pilot.ふわふわ: A dandelion seed puff and a light cloud-like pancake floating weightlessly in the air, airy pastel colours.
pilot.もこもこ: A child wearing a thick fluffy fleece jacket with a big hood, the fleece looks dense and woolly, winter morning.
pilot.つるつる: A freshly peeled boiled egg held up with glossy perfectly smooth shiny surface, close-up.
pilot.ざらざら: A hand rubbing over a rough coarse sandpaper-like surface with visible grain, grey-brown tones, close-up.
pilot.ぴかぴか: A freshly polished silver kettle and a spotless gleaming floor in a tidy kitchen, everything clean and shiny.
pilot.きらきら: Small stars and water droplets twinkling and sparkling in the night sky above a calm lake, points of light glittering.
pilot.ぐっすり: A person sleeping deeply in a bed at night, calm face, tucked in under a blanket, moonlight through the window.
pilot.ぐるぐる: A cat chasing its own tail, spinning round and round in a circle, with curved motion trails.
pilot.のろのろ: A snail slowly crawling along a path while a rabbit runs by far ahead in the distance, a very slow pace.
pilot.すたすた: A businessperson briskly walking straight ahead along a pavement with long confident strides, not looking around.
pilot.ぷくぷく: A small goldfish blowing little round bubbles up in a clear fishbowl, plump round bubbles floating up.
pilot.どろどろ: Thick gooey brown mud and a boot stuck in it, mud dripping off the boot, a muddy field.
